entries.title: Psalms 3:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David. When he went in flight from Absalom his son.> Lord, how greatly are they increased who make attacks on me! in great numbers they come against me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:2
segments: Unnumbered are those who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 3:3
segments: But your strength, O Lord, is round me, you are my glory and the lifter up of my head.

entries.title: Psalms 3:4
segments: ¶I send up a cry to the Lord with my voice, and he gives me an answer from his holy hill. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 3:5
segments: I took my rest in sleep, and then again I was awake; for the Lord was my support.

entries.title: Psalms 3:6
segments: I will have no fear, though ten thousand have come round me, putting themselves against me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:7
segments: Come to me, Lord; keep me safe, O my God; for you have given all my haters blows on their face-bones; the teeth of the evil-doers have been broken by you.

entries.title: Psalms 3:8
segments: Salvation comes from the Lord; your blessing is on your people. (Selah.)
